programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: This time the destination is Belgium, Brussels - the very heart of the European Union.Martyna Wojciechowska manages, among others,to one of the capital's districts, Molenbeek, where he talks to the mothers of jihadists.It turns out that more than five thousand people left the Old Continent, and more than five hundred people left Belgium itself.They all left to fight on the side of the so-called Islamic State.We are talking about young people, women and children.The traveler tries to find out why they decided to join a terrorist organization.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: For Martyna Wojciechowska, the most important value is freedom.During her travels in the ninth season of the program, she decided to show what she means to others - her characters.The Malaysian fish people have cut themselves off from civilization.The Kazakh girl breaks all stereotypes and excels in activities reserved only for men.Pakistani Masarrat Misbah, thanks to her courage, is changing the world, restoring freedom to others.Kalashka Iran Bibi lives according to the centuries-old tradition of his ancestors despite external pressures.In Japan, Martyna Wojciechowska found people free from any prejudices.However, sometimes honest conversations bring further questions - about the price that Bolivian cholitas pay for their independence;about whether jihadist mothers could limit the freedom of their children, and whether Mennonites are making the right choice by consciously deciding on a life limited by rigid rules.

programs.title: Asian Times
programs.desc: Julian Hanton visits Asia.It checks what changes are taking place on the continent, where economic recovery goes hand in hand with population growth.The leader begins his journey in Hong Kong, where he inadvertently agrees to take a punch from Bruce Lee.This experience will be remembered for a long time.In Thailand, he makes friends with investigative journalists, becomes a secret agent and monitors local gambling.In the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia and China, he carefully observes people and their behavior.He discovers that all corners of the world are an inexhaustible source of knowledge.

programs.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programs.desc: Andrew Zimmern begins another culinary adventure, during which he will again taste the strangest dishes in the world, from wild goat to duck liver.In the new season of the show, Andrew will taste snake eggs in Japan and drink snake bile in Shanghai.In Okinawa, people eat pickled pig's ear, poisonous urchin fish and tuna eye.Finally, he will go to China to try turtle, chicken hearts and snail shells.Viewers will find out whether Andrew will survive such a difficult test.
